title: Upstream drainage area on the 15-minute grid
description: Native-grid raster of Mekong upstream drainage area.
purpose: Show the spatial distribution of contributing area across the regional river map.
method: Native-grid raster with full-map logarithmic normalization by default.
data_source: Git-tracked CaMa-Flood Mekong 15-minute map; no simulation output required.
data_preparation: Inputs are already tracked; run visualization/river_map/f01-rivmap-uparea.sh after the standard Python setup.

title: Station-to-grid-cell linkage
description: Station coordinates linked to the centers of the containing Mekong 15-minute cells.
purpose: Show the geometric association between observed point locations and the model grid.
method: Pale logarithmic uparea raster with uniform station-to-cell arrows.
data_source: Git-tracked Mekong map and in-domain station locations from map/data/GRDC_allocated.csv.
column20: 8–20°N subset of GRDC-allocated sites and containing-cell indices; run the project Shell script after standard Python setup.

title: Station-to-grid linkage scaled by drainage area
description: Station-to-cell link color and width encode the linked cell's upstream drainage area.
purpose: Compare contributing area at the model cells associated with the displayed stations.
method: Logarithmic linked-cell upstream-area scaling for arrow color and width over a pale logarithmic uparea raster.
data_source: Git-tracked Mekong map and in-domain station locations from map/data/GRDC_allocated.csv.
column20: 8–20°N subset of GRDC-allocated sites and containing-cell indices; run the project Shell script after standard Python setup.
